dslRule:
<!id: add.volatile.to.private.boolean.field.initialized.false>
<!description: Adds 'volatile' modifier to a private boolean field initialized to 'false', removing the redundant initialization as 'false' is the default for booleans. This improves visibility in multi-threaded contexts.
Requires manual review to confirm thread-safety implications.>
<!severity: WARNING>
private boolean $name = false;
=>
private volatile boolean $name;
;;
summary: Adds 'volatile' to private boolean fields initialized to false and removes the redundant initializer.
